notes: Fiscal year ended September 27, 2026 (data.js fy 'Sep 2026'); this edition skips FY2025. Financial figures are from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0000804328-26-000128, filed November 4, 2026) and match SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the proxy for the March 2026 annual meeting (DEF 14A filed January 22, 2026, accession 0001104659-26-005781), the latest proxy, with percentages based on 1,062,916,212 shares outstanding on December 15, 2025. LEADER: Irwin M. Jacobs, co-founder, is not a director, nominee, named executive officer or 5% holder in the 2026 proxy (his name does not appear in it), so no holding is reported. HOLDERS: the proxy still applies Vanguard's May 31, 2024 and BlackRock's December 31, 2023 Schedule 13G/A holdings to the December 15, 2025 share count, so both are stale. GEOGRAPHY: revenue by the headquarters location of the customer or licensee, not where devices are sold. BUYBACKS exclude $1,134 million of tax withholdings on vesting share awards.
